citations.assessment: The Yerushalmi explicitly gives Yitzḥak bar Mari before Yose bei Rabbi Avin in Yoḥanan’s name. The later Bavli Kaskasa’ah entry is a different name form in a related discussion.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
